Name: Craterfield
Description: Controls the overall size (radius) of craters in the field.

Name: Scale
Description: Controls the overall size (radius) of craters in the field.

Name: Depth
Description: Controls how deep the craters carve into the terrain.

Name: Density
Description: Controls how many craters are generated across the terrain (higher values create more impacts).

Name: Seed
Description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process.

Name: Position
Description: Offsets the craterfield along the X axis.

Name: X
Description: Offsets the craterfield along the X axis.

Name: Y
Description: Offsets the craterfield along the Y axis.
